environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in an ECS Fargate task behind API Gateway. The task definition specifies a custom Linux capabilities configuration with CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN dropped from the container's capability bounding set. Additionally, the DynamoDB table has a resource-based policy with a Condition block using dynamodb:Attributes ForAllValues:StringEquals constraint that restricts UpdateItem operations to only the attributes ['displayName', 'email', 'avatarUrl', 'bio', 'timezone']. The IAM permission boundary attached to the task execution role includes an explicit Deny on dynamodb:UpdateItem when the dynamodb:Attributes condition key includes 'role', 'isAdmin', 'permissions', or 'tier'. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with runtime seccomp profile set to runtime/default.
